source: You'll have opened for you all the riches of the Orient, luxurious gardens vast in number, that ordinary men spend years trying to conquer. No delay for you, though: a fumble here, a fumble there, you finger the merchandise.
translation: 你将为你打开东方的所有财富，大量的豪华花园，普通人花费数年时间试图征服的。不过，对你来说，没有耽搁：这里摸索，那里摸索，你就能找到商品。
